other_failure_modes.name: Train/Test temporal boundary disconnect
other_failure_modes.description: Temporal features (like lags and rolling statistics) are calculated independently on the train and test sets. This breaks the temporal continuity at the boundary, causing the first few rows of the test set to have incorrect or missing lag values because they cannot access the tail end of the training set.

other_failure_modes.name: Creating artificial temporal gaps before lag calculations
other_failure_modes.description: Rows with missing target values are dropped prior to calculating lag and rolling window features. This creates irregular time intervals and artificial gaps in the series, meaning a 'lag of 1' might actually jump across several dropped time steps rather than representing the true previous state.

summary: The agent provides a generally solid solution, employing proper time-based cross validation (TimeSeriesSplit) and extracting temporal features without data leakage across the train/val split. However, applying lag feature engineering to train and test sets independently fails to carry over the temporal boundary context, and dropping missing targets before computing lags introduces artificial temporal gaps. Additionally, the agent only relies on the primary AUC metric without secondary metrics.
